questions.q: What was the King's palace made of?
choices: Stone
Mud
Palm-leaves
Wood and grass
questions.evidence: the King's palace which was made of mud

questions.q: Where was Prince Bumpo when the Doctor arrived at the palace?
choices: Asleep in his bed-room at the back of the palace
Away fishing for salmon in the river
Out hunting elephants with the King's soldiers
At a dance at his cousin's house
questions.evidence: The Prince was away fishing for salmon in the river.

questions.q: Why would the King not let the Doctor travel through his lands?
choices: He was afraid the Doctor would make his people sick like the monkeys
A man he once helped took gold and ivory and left without thanks
He wanted the Doctor to stay and be the doctor for the royal family
He did not believe that any man could talk to animals at all
questions.evidence: he went away secretly in his ship--without so much as saying 'Thank you.'

questions.q: Where had Polynesia hidden so she would not be put in a cage?
choices: Under Queen Ermintrude's big umbrella by the palace door
Inside the Doctor's high hat
In the pocket in the tail of the Doctor's coat
In the trunk with the white mouse
questions.evidence: climbing out of the pocket in the tail of the Doctor's coat

questions.q: Polynesia calls her hiding trick a "ruse." What is a ruse?
choices: A loud noise made to frighten an enemy away
A clever trick to fool someone
A small cage for birds
A secret path through the jungle

questions.q: How did Polynesia get into the palace that night?
choices: She flew down the chimney into the kitchen
She slipped under the front door while all the guards were asleep
She went in through a pantry window broken by a tennis ball
She hid in the Queen's bag as the Queen came home
questions.evidence: The pantry window had been broken by a tennis ball the week before

questions.q: Why did the King believe the voice in his bedroom was the Doctor?
choices: Polynesia could mimic anyone, and she coughed, talked and laughed just like the Doctor
The King had never heard a parrot speak, so he did not know birds could talk
Polynesia stood in the dark doorway wearing the Doctor's high hat and coat
The Queen had told him the Doctor was coming to the palace that night

questions.q: What did Polynesia say would happen if the King did not open the dungeon door?
choices: His palace would fall down before the morning sun rose
All the animals of the jungle would come and chase him away
He would have mumps before the morning sun had risen
The monkeys would steal all of the gold he had in the palace
questions.evidence: you shall have mumps before the morning sun has risen

questions.q: How did the King find out that he had been tricked?
choices: A soldier saw the parrot fly out of the dungeon window in the moonlight
The Queen saw the parrot getting out through the broken glass
Prince Bumpo heard the parrot laughing in the stairway
The palace cat found green feathers under the King's bed
questions.evidence: saw the parrot getting out through the broken glass

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How Queen Ermintrude went to a dance at her cousin's house
How Gub-Gub learned to stop crying when things went wrong
How Polynesia tricked the King into setting the Doctor free
How the King's soldiers built a strong new stone prison for the Doctor
questions.evidence: Then the King understood that he had been tricked
